svg.title: Harsha — Developer Profile
svg.desc: A blueprint-style developer profile for Katta Harsha Vardhan: positioning, selected work, other builds, stack, how he works, open questions, and a title block.
svg.text: I build full-stack products, ML systems and developer tools.
Final-year AI & ML undergrad in Bengaluru. Not a student who codes — a person who builds things to understand them,
then breaks them to understand them better.
Three projects that show the range: ML, full-stack and developer tooling.
Spots synthetic speech. Wav2Vec2 model built with PyTorch and HuggingFace, served through
FastAPI, shipped in Docker, with a Flutter front end. Best validation EER: 0.25%.
End to end platform for a 24-hour national hackathon: landing page, participant portal for
teams and submissions, admin center for judging and audit logs, public certificate check.
A keyboard-driven terminal navigator for Windows PowerShell with zero dependencies. UI renders
to stderr so stdout stays clean for piping. Install it as @harshakatta/termnav.
More of the surface area: creative code, tools, systems and hackathon builds.
Digital ink painting in WebGL and GLSL,
ALSO: SecureFile-X · DiskWizard · Interview Co-Pilot · Stayza · Textflow · VTU result scraper
Flutter document scanner · Android cellular diagnostics app
on every project. AI coding tools implement
coursework gathers dust · experiments do not.
